changes.comment: Add quantity formatting for FieldRun values in text annotations. `ElementDrivesTextAnnotation.evaluateFieldsAsync` runs the full pipeline against an injected `FormatsProvider` / `UnitsProvider`; `collectFieldFormattingRequirements` reports the `(KindOfQuantity, persistenceUnit)` pairs a host must pre-warm. The synchronous `evaluateFields` and txn field-update callbacks continue to render raw unless the host registers a `FormattingSpecProvider` for the field's `formatSet` via `registerFieldFormattingProvider` (matching `unregisterFieldFormattingProvider` on iModel close is caller-owned).
